meta.source: INQAAHE (International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education), members database
meta.note: Full members are quality assurance or accreditation agencies. Membership is not government recognition: some are national regulators, others are private accreditors. Confirm a body's legal role with the country's ministry or regulator.
